summary.text: NCUA is currently using artificial intelligence for content generation, flagging anomalies in Call Report data, forecasting loan performance, and enhancing cybersecurity operations (s1). The agency provides resources on AI-specific risk management to help credit unions make informed decisions when implementing AI or partnering with AI service providers (s2). NCUA is evaluating opportunities to utilize the General Services Administration’s USAi shared services, which provides access to multiple AI models in a FedRAMP-secured environment (s3). The agency has added an AI Resources page to its website that includes information on use cases, implementation, risk management, data security, and cybersecurity risks (s7, s8).
